# get_bond_types { #mofography.analyze.get_bond_types }

`analyze.get_bond_types(bond_orders)`

It takes a list of bond orders and returns a list of bond types

## Parameters

| Name          | Type   | Description                                      | Default    |
|---------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `bond_orders` |        | a list of bond orders, e.g. [1.0, 2.0, 1.0, 3.0] | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                         |
|--------|-------------------------------------|
|        | A pandas series with the bond types |
